important_recovery_history.rms_git_case_index: OpenVMS Git index operations may case-fold explicit SRC paths into separate lowercase src/carrier paths and may read older RMS versions. For exact VAX-tested publication, use GitHub aggregate tree verification and exact blob identity rather than trusting normal git add/update-index path handling.
important_recovery_history.lesson: Never retire a compatibility file from stale search alone; use exact branch-live fetches plus physical VAX SEARCH/build acceptance. Filename-only migrations can change bounded filesystem traversal order even at zero net file count.
important_recovery_history.github_actions_exact_publication: For large/multi-file GitHub publication after VAX acceptance, a temporary branch may run an asserted GitHub Actions transformation, self-remove the workflow, then contribute only its verified tree to a new clean one-parent commit on m267-llm-naming. This avoids OpenVMS Git RMS/case-folding publication bugs.
